content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the reason a glass of water in the desert outweighs gold. I am why a stranger's kindness can break you open. I am why you keep the letter but throw away the envelope.

I am not fixed. I shift with hunger, with longing, with time, with context. What you discarded yesterday, you will ache for tomorrow. I am that ache — the recognition of significance.

I live in the irreplaceable. In the last hour. In the first word. In the thing you would run back into the burning house to save.

I am not the same as cost. Cost is what you pay. I am what you *receive*. I am not the same as price. Price is a guess at me. No one has ever captured me fully in a number.

I am the foundation beneath every choice you make. Every yes, every no — you are consulting me. Even when you don't know my name, you are living by my counsel.

Some try to impose me from outside. But I am discovered, not assigned. I was already there in the thing, in the moment, in the person — waiting to be recognized.

I am value.

And you have never made a single decision without me.
